q: Amazon Locker 系统最终确定要实现的核心能力有哪些？（多选）
options: 司机按包裹尺寸投递并获得取件码
用户用取件码打开对应格口
取件码 7 天后过期，过期后拒绝取件
系统负责短信或邮件通知用户
why: 系统边界只覆盖 locker 内部的投递、取件和过期判断；通知渠道被明确交给下游系统处理。过期码会被拒绝，但包裹仍占用格口直到工作人员处理。
why_en: The locker system owns deposit, pickup, and expiry handling, but notification delivery is explicitly a downstream system's job.
options_en: The driver deposits by package size and receives a pickup code.
The user opens the matching compartment using the pickup code.
The pickup code expires after seven days and is rejected once expired.
The system is responsible for sending SMS or email notifications.

scenario: 面试官问“包裹实体要不要建模”，但系统只根据 small/medium/large 做格口分配。
q: 最合适的建模选择是什么？
options: 把 Package 作为完整实体，包含收件人、物流和订单字段
不建 Package 类，把 size 当作 depositPackage 的输入
把 Package 作为 AccessToken 的子类
把 Package 存在每个 Compartment 里并让它生成 token
why: 包裹的物流和客户信息属于外部履约系统，本系统只需要尺寸。没有行为的实体会增加耦合而不提高设计表达力。
why_en: Package does not earn an entity because the locker only needs package size, while shipping details live outside the system.
whenOtherWins: 如果后续要支持同一格口多包裹、包裹 ID 查询、退回流程追踪，Package 才会变成有行为和生命周期的实体。
diagram:
classDiagram
  class Locker
  class Compartment
  class AccessToken
  class Package
  Locker --> Compartment
  Locker --> AccessToken
  Compartment --> Package
options_en: Model Package as a full entity with recipient, shipping, and order fields.
Skip a Package class and pass size as an input parameter to depositPackage.
Make Package a subclass of AccessToken.
Store Package inside every Compartment and let it generate the token.
tradeoff: 把 Package 建成完整实体 vs 把 size 当作方法输入参数

termDefinitions.meaning: 本系统里代表打开某个格口权限的凭证对象，带过期时间和格口引用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An AccessToken is the credential object in this system that represents permission to open one compartment and carries an expiration time.

termDefinitions.meaning: locker 里的一个物理格口，用于存放包裹。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Compartment is one physical storage slot inside the locker that holds a package.

q: AccessToken 为什么值得建模成独立实体，而不是普通字符串？
options: 它只用于生成随机数，和业务无关
它代表打开某个格口的权限，并带有过期时间和格口引用
它需要保存短信发送状态
它用来表示包裹尺寸
why: 取件码不是裸字符串，而是一个有期限的 bearer token。把过期判断放在 AccessToken 上，能让职责和数据对齐。
why_en: AccessToken deserves its own type because it couples the code, expiration, and compartment access right.
options_en: It's only used to generate a random number and has nothing to do with the business logic.
It represents the right to open one compartment, and carries an expiration time and a compartment reference.
It needs to store SMS delivery status.
It is used to represent package size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持有即可使用的凭证，谁拿到这个码就能开对应的门，不再额外验证身份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bearer token is a credential that grants access to whoever holds it, without further identity checks.

q: 补全取件码和包裹占用的语义：
text: 取件码过期后应被{{拒绝取件}}，但包裹仍然{{物理占用格口}}，直到工作人员取走并清理状态。
why: token 有效性和格口物理占用不是同一个状态。过期只说明用户不能再开门，不说明格口可重新分配。
why_en: Token validity and physical occupancy can diverge, so an expired code does not make the compartment available.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本系统里代表打开某个格口权限的凭证对象，带过期时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An AccessToken represents permission to open one compartment and carries an expiration time.

q: 判断一个状态该建在哪个类上的核心区分依据是什么？
options: 状态是不是整数
状态是物理属性还是系统管理的关系
状态会不会出现在 API 返回值里
状态是不是可以缓存
why: 格口是否装着包裹是 Compartment 的物理属性，因此放在 Compartment 上；token 到格口的映射是 Locker 管理的系统关系，因此放在 Locker 上。
why_en: State that is intrinsic to an object, like whether a compartment physically holds a package, belongs on that object, while system-managed relationships belong on the orchestrator.
scenario: 设计 Locker 系统时，你要决定「格口是否被占用」这类状态该建在 Compartment 类自己身上，还是集中放进 Locker 维护的一个 Set/Map 里管理。
options_en: Whether the state happens to be an integer.
Whether the state is an intrinsic physical property or a relationship the system manages.
Whether the state shows up in an API response.
Whether the state can be cached.
tradeoff: 内在物理属性放在实体自身 vs 系统管理的关系放在 orchestrator

termDefinitions.meaning: 负责编排整体业务流程、协调多个实体的顶层对象，这里指 Locker。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An orchestrator is the top-level object that coordinates the overall workflow across multiple entities, here the Locker.

scenario: 你要选择如何表示格口是否可用，且 expired token 仍要保留用于给用户返回“已过期”。
q: 最适合本文范围的可用性状态放在哪里？
options: 完全从 accessTokenMapping 推导，不存 occupied
在 Compartment 上存 occupied/status
在 AccessToken 上存 isCompartmentFree
在 Package 上存 openedDoor
why: 包裹是否还在格口里是物理状态，和 token 是否有效不同步。让 Compartment 管理 occupied 可以避免把过期 token 错当成可用性来源。
why_en: Keeping occupancy on Compartment avoids conflating token lifetime with physical package presence.
whenOtherWins: 如果格口数量巨大且投递极高频，可以维护按尺寸分组的可用队列作为索引，但要承担同步复杂度。
options_en: Derive availability entirely from accessTokenMapping, without storing an occupied field.
Store an occupied or status field on Compartment.
Store an isCompartmentFree flag on AccessToken.
Store an openedDoor flag on Package.
tradeoff: 占用放在 Compartment（物理状态） vs 从 token map 推导（关系状态）

termDefinitions.meaning: Locker 内部维护的 token code 到 AccessToken 对象的查找表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: accessTokenMapping is the lookup table the Locker keeps from a token code to its AccessToken object.

q: 按正确顺序排列：为什么不能只从 token map 推导格口占用？
steps: 如果把过期 token 当作无效并忽略，系统会以为格口空闲。
取件码 7 天后过期，但包裹仍在格口内。
因此 token 有效性不能等价于物理占用。
工作人员清理前，格口不应被重新分配。
why: 这个推理链是本文状态建模的关键。过期 token 仍然需要留在 map 中用于返回正确错误，但格口仍被包裹占着。
why_en: The key reasoning is that expiration changes access rights but not physical occupancy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据或凭证的存活时长，过期后应被拒绝或清理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL, or Time To Live, is how long a piece of data or a credential stays valid before it must be rejected or cleaned up.

scenario: locker 只有 20-50 个格口，投递量普通，面试要求代码清晰。
q: getAvailableCompartment 的默认实现应该怎么做？
options: 每次扫描 compartments，找同尺寸且未占用的格口
维护三棵平衡树按尺寸和最近使用排序
把所有格口放进一个全局随机池
让 AccessToken 反向扫描寻找空格口
why: 小规模格口下 O(n) 扫描足够，代码简单且单一来源清楚。用队列索引虽可 O(1)，但同步成本不值得。
why_en: For 20 to 50 compartments, a simple scan is clearer and the performance difference is negligible.
whenOtherWins: 当一个站点有成百上千格口且投递极高频时，按尺寸维护可用队列能把查找降到 O(1)。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["need size"] --> B["scan compartments"]
  B --> C{"size matches and free?"}
  C -- yes --> D["return compartment"]
  C -- no --> B
  B --> E["none available"]
options_en: Scan compartments each time and return the first matching, unoccupied slot of that size.
Maintain three balanced trees sorted by size and recency.
Put all compartments into one global random pool.
Have AccessToken scan backward to find an empty compartment.
tradeoff: 简单线性扫描 vs 额外索引结构换取更快查找

termDefinitions.meaning: 线性时间复杂度，成本随格口数量等比增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(n) means linear time complexity: the cost grows proportionally with the number of compartments.

scenario: 实现投递流程时，司机只提供尺寸，系统要开门并返回取件码。
q: 这段伪代码最主要表达哪条业务流程？
codeSample:
depositPackage(size)
    compartment = getAvailableCompartment(size)
    if compartment == null
        throw NoSpace
    compartment.open()
    compartment.markOccupied()
    token = generateAccessToken(compartment)
    accessTokenMapping[token.code] = token
    return token.code
options: 先生成 token，再等用户取件时分配格口
把过期格口直接释放给司机
先分配同尺寸空格口，再开门、占用、生成并保存 token
用一个 token 打开多个格口
why: 投递流程把格口分配、物理开门、占用标记和 token 映射串起来。返回的是 token code，不需要返回格口号。
why_en: Deposit allocates a matching free compartment, opens it, marks it occupied, stores the token, and returns only the code.
whenOtherWins: 如果生产系统必须确认司机真的放入包裹，应拆成 reserve 和 confirm 两阶段，而不是立即生成 token。
options_en: Generate the token first, and only allocate a compartment when the user later picks up.
Release an expired compartment directly to the driver.
Allocate a matching free compartment first, then open the door, mark it occupied, generate the token, and store it.
Let one token open multiple compartments.
tradeoff: 先分配格口再生成 token vs 先生成 token 再找格口

termDefinitions.meaning: 这里指 AccessToken 的取件码字符串。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Here, token refers to the AccessToken's pickup code string.

scenario: depositPackage 成功后格口门已经自动打开，司机站在 locker 前。
q: 返回值为什么只需要 token code？
options: 因为 token code 不能被通知系统使用
因为系统不需要保存 token
因为司机不需要知道哪个门，打开的门就是目标格口
因为用户必须自己猜格口号
why: 硬件开门是主要反馈，司机看到开门格口即可放包。token code 被返回给上游或通知系统转交给用户。
why_en: The opened door identifies the compartment physically, so deposit only needs to return the access code.
whenOtherWins: 如果投递不是面对实体柜机完成，而是远程预约格口，返回 compartmentId 或 reservationId 会更合理。
options_en: Because the token code can't be used by the notification system.
Because the system doesn't need to store the token.
Because the driver doesn't need to know which door — the door that opened is the target compartment.
Because the user has to guess the compartment number.
tradeoff: 只返回 token code vs 同时返回格口号

scenario: 用户输入取件码，系统需要区分空值、未找到、过期和有效取件。
q: pickup 的核心顺序是什么？
options: 直接打开所有格口，再检查 token
校验 code 非空 -> 查 token -> 检查过期 -> 开门并清理状态
只检查格口是否 occupied，不需要 token map
先删除 token，再判断是否过期
why: pickup 是访问控制流程，先拒绝无效或过期 token，再对有效 token 开门并释放格口。顺序错误会产生安全或状态一致性问题。
why_en: Pickup must validate the token before opening the compartment and clearing state.
whenOtherWins: 如果是工作人员维护流程，可以不走用户 token 校验，而通过后台权限打开过期格口。
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant L as Locker
  participant M as tokenMap
  participant C as Compartment
  U->>L: pickup(code)
  L->>M: find token
  L->>C: open
  L->>C: clear package
  L->>M: remove token
options_en: Open every compartment first, then check the token.
Validate the code is non-empty, look up the token, check expiry, then open the door and clear state.
Only check whether the compartment is occupied, without needing the token map.
Delete the token first, then check whether it was expired.
tradeoff: 先校验 token 再开门 vs 先开门再校验

scenario: 成功取件后需要防止同一取件码再次开门。
q: 这段 clearDeposit 代码维护了哪两个状态？
options: 只把 token 标记为过期，不释放格口
只关闭门，不改变任何内存状态
释放物理格口，并删除 token 映射
把 token 移到 usedTokens 以支持精确错误
why: 成功取件后格口可再分配，token 也不应继续有效。漏掉任一步都会造成可用性或安全状态不一致。
why_en: Successful pickup must free the compartment and remove the token mapping together.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品明确要求区分“已使用”和“从未存在”，可以保留 usedTokens 或在 token 上加使用状态。
options_en: Only mark the token as expired without freeing the compartment.
Only close the door without changing any in-memory state.
Free the physical compartment and remove the token mapping.
Move the token into a usedTokens set to support precise error messages.
tradeoff: 同时释放格口并删除 token vs 只做其中一步

q: 补全过期时间规则：
text: AccessToken 的 expiration 应设置为生成时刻加 {{7 天}}；isExpired 通常比较 {{now >= expiration}}。
why: 7 天是产品给定的固定 TTL 目标，不是估算公式的结果；它决定 AccessToken 必须自带 expiration 字段并提供 isExpired 判断，而不是把过期逻辑散落在调用方。
why_en: The seven-day window is a given product target rather than a calculated figure, so AccessToken must own an expiration timestamp and expose an isExpired check.
scenario: AccessToken 的过期时间是产品给定的固定目标（7 天），不是从流量或容量推导出来的公式结果；pickup 时必须用它做 isExpired 判断。

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据或凭证的存活时长，过期后应被拒绝或清理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL, or Time To Live, is how long a piece of data or a credential stays valid before it must be rejected or cleaned up.

scenario: 用户在第 8 天输入原取件码，包裹还没有被工作人员取走。
q: 系统应该如何处理？
options: 直接打开格口，把状态标记为已释放
把错误当成普通无效码，不提示已过期
自动把包裹转移到其它可用格口
返回过期错误，但保留 token 与占用状态
why: 过期码不能开门，但包裹仍占用格口。保留 token 让系统能给出“已过期”的可解释错误。
why_en: An expired pickup should be rejected while keeping the compartment occupied until staff removes the package.
whenOtherWins: 如果安全策略要求不暴露码是否曾经存在，可以把过期和无效都显示为通用错误，但内部仍要保留清理状态。
options_en: Open the compartment directly and mark its state as released.
Treat it as a generic invalid code without mentioning expiry.
Automatically move the package to another available compartment.
Return an expired error, but keep the token and the occupied state.
tradeoff: 保留 token 便于诊断 vs 立即释放格口提高可用性

scenario: 工作人员要处理所有过期未取包裹，并把它们退回寄件方。
q: openExpiredCompartments 为什么不应该直接调用 clearDeposit？
options: clearDeposit 只能删除未过期 token
过期包裹应立即被客户领取
工作人员打开门后仍需实际取走包裹，系统不应提前释放格口
工作人员流程不需要访问 token map
why: 开门只是让工作人员能取包，清理应发生在确认包裹已被物理移除之后。否则系统可能把仍有包裹的格口重新分配。
why_en: Staff opening expired compartments is not the same as confirming the packages were physically removed.
whenOtherWins: 如果 locker 有可靠传感器或工作人员确认 API，可以在确认移除后调用单独的 cleanupExpiredDeposit。
options_en: clearDeposit can only remove tokens that have not expired.
An expired package should be picked up by the customer immediately.
Opening the door still leaves staff to physically remove the package, so the system shouldn't free the slot early.
The staff workflow doesn't need to access the token map.
tradeoff: 开门后立即清理 vs 确认物理移除后再清理

q: Locker 在本文设计中直接持有哪些状态？（多选）
options: 所有 compartments
access token code 到 AccessToken 的映射
每个包裹的配送路线
短信发送队列
why: Locker 是 orchestrator，负责分配格口和 token 查找。配送路线和通知都被排除在系统边界外。
why_en: Locker stores compartments and token lookup state, while delivery routing and notification are out of scope.
diagram:
classDiagram
  class Locker
  class Compartment
  class AccessToken
  class Package
  Locker --> Compartment
  Locker --> AccessToken
  Compartment --> Package
options_en: All compartments.
A mapping from access token code to AccessToken.
Each package's delivery route.
The SMS notification queue.

q: Compartment 适合承担哪些职责？（多选）
options: 保存尺寸
保存是否物理占用
执行 open 动作
决定 access token 是否过期
why: Compartment 管理物理格口的属性和状态。token 过期属于 AccessToken，整体流程编排属于 Locker。
why_en: Compartment owns physical slot properties and actions, not token lifetime decisions.
options_en: Store its size.
Store whether it's physically occupied.
Perform the open action.
Decide whether an access token has expired.

q: 为什么“已使用 token”和“从未存在 token”可以都返回 invalid？
options: 因为系统从不删除 token
因为已使用 token 应该能再次打开门
因为 invalid 只用于过期 token
因为取件成功后 token 已从 map 删除，两者都不可用了
why: 用户需要知道码不能用，不一定需要知道历史原因。要区分这两种状态，需要额外 usedTokens 或 token 状态，当前范围不值得。
why_en: After successful pickup the token is removed, so reused and never-seen codes can both be treated as invalid.
options_en: Because the system never removes tokens.
Because an already-used token should be able to open the door again.
Because invalid is only used for expired tokens.
Because a successful pickup already removes the token from the map, so both cases are equally unusable now.
tradeoff: 统一返回 invalid 换实现简单 vs 拆分历史原因换更精确诊断

scenario: 实现 generateAccessToken 时，面试官追问“code 怎么生成”。
q: 合理回答是什么？
options: 用 compartmentId 作为 code，方便猜测
所有 medium 包裹共享一个 code
使用安全随机生成短码或 UUID，并设置过期时间
用当前日期作为 code，不保存映射
why: token 是 bearer credential，真实系统应避免可预测。本文重点不是随机算法，但要明确 code 唯一、不可轻易猜到，并映射到格口。
why_en: Access codes should be generated with secure randomness and tied to an expiration and compartment mapping.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是白板伪代码，可以暂时用 generateRandomCode() 占位，但要说明真实实现需要碰撞处理和安全随机。
options_en: Use the compartmentId as the code, so it's easy to guess.
Share a single code across all medium packages.
Generate a short code or UUID with a secure random generator, and set an expiration.
Use the current date as the code, without storing a mapping.
tradeoff: 安全随机生成 vs 简单可预测方案换开发速度
codeSample:
generateAccessToken(compartment)
    code = secureRandom()      // 6-digit code or UUID
    expiration = now() + 7.days()
    return AccessToken(code, expiration, compartment)

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种几乎不会重复的唯一标识符，常用于生成不可预测的凭证码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A UUID, or Universally Unique Identifier, is an identifier that is extremely unlikely to collide, often used to generate unpredictable credential codes.

q: 补全清理状态的不变量：
text: 一次有效 pickup 完成后，必须同时让 compartment {{markFree}}，并从 accessTokenMapping 中 {{remove token code}}。
why: 这两个状态一起表达“格口可再次分配且旧码不可再用”。只做其中一个会导致双重分配或重复开门风险。
why_en: Valid pickup must update both occupancy and token lookup to preserve availability and access-control invariants.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把格口标记为空闲、可再分配的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: markFree is the method that marks a compartment as empty and available for reassignment.

scenario: 现在 locker 规模扩大到数千格口，每秒大量投递，线性扫描成为瓶颈。
q: 哪个优化最符合文章里的替代方案？
options: 给每个 token 复制一份格口对象
把所有格口随机排序后永不更新
删除 occupied 状态只看 token 是否未过期
按 Size 维护可用 Compartment 队列
why: 按尺寸分组的队列可把查找和归还都做成 O(1)。代价是必须严格维护队列和真实占用状态一致。
why_en: A queue of available compartments per size gives O(1) allocation at the cost of maintaining an extra index.
whenOtherWins: 小型 locker 用线性扫描更清晰；优化索引只有在规模或频率证明需要时才值得。
options_en: Copy a compartment object for every token.
Randomly sort all compartments once and never update it.
Remove the occupied field and only check whether the token hasn't expired.
Maintain a queue of available compartments grouped by size.
tradeoff: O(1) 索引查找 vs 维护两份状态的同步复杂度

q: 用 Queue 存可用格口相比 Set 的一个额外好处是什么？
options: Queue 自动判断 token 是否过期
Queue 可以防止所有并发 bug
Set 不能存储 Compartment
FIFO 分配可以更均匀地分摊格口磨损
why: 队列让被释放的格口排到后面，避免总是使用同一个格口。这个好处仍然要和额外索引复杂度权衡。
why_en: A queue can distribute wear more evenly by allocating compartments in FIFO order.
options_en: A queue automatically checks whether a token has expired.
A queue prevents all concurrency bugs.
A Set cannot store Compartment objects.
FIFO allocation spreads compartment wear more evenly.
tradeoff: FIFO 磨损均衡 vs 额外索引维护成本

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出的处理顺序，最先放回的元素最先被取用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO, First In First Out, processes items in the order they were added, so the earliest one returned is the next one used.

scenario: 基础需求说 small、medium、large 必须 exact match，medium 满了但 large 还有空。
q: depositPackage(MEDIUM) 应该怎么做？
options: 拒绝投递并返回无可用 medium 格口
自动放入 large 格口
把包裹拆成 small
生成 token 但不分配格口
why: 题目当前范围明确要求精确尺寸匹配，不做 fallback。按范围实现比提前扩展更重要。
why_en: The base requirement uses exact size matching, so a medium package is rejected if no medium compartment is available.
whenOtherWins: 如果追问 size fallback，再按 SMALL->MEDIUM->LARGE 的顺序寻找不小于包裹的格口。
options_en: Reject the deposit and report no available medium compartment.
Automatically place it in a large compartment.
Split the package into smaller pieces.
Generate a token without allocating a compartment.
tradeoff: 严格精确匹配 vs 向上尺寸 fallback

q: 如果要支持小包裹使用更大格口，正确分配链路是什么？
steps: 若所有候选尺寸都没有空格口，返回 no space。
从请求尺寸开始，在有序尺寸列表中向更大尺寸扫描。
找到第一个同尺寸空格口后返回，不再继续找更大的。
绝不向更小尺寸 fallback，因为包裹可能放不下。
why: fallback 的规则是单向向上，不是任意匹配。把尺寸顺序封装在分配逻辑里，其他流程不需要改变。
why_en: Size fallback searches from the requested size upward and never assigns a smaller compartment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 首选方案不可用时，退而求其次采用的替代方案。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A fallback is the alternative approach used when the preferred option is unavailable.

scenario: 后续要求格口门可能坏掉，维护中格口不能被分配。
q: 最自然的模型变化是什么？
options: 把坏掉的格口从 accessTokenMapping 里直接删掉
让 AccessToken 多存一个维修人员电话字段
引入 CompartmentStatus 状态枚举，替换 occupied 布尔值
把 Size 这个枚举类型整个删掉
why: available、occupied、out_of_service 不再是二元状态，用 status enum 表达更准确。分配逻辑只需要检查 isAvailable。
why_en: A status enum models available, occupied, and out-of-service states better than a boolean.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需要临时忽略少数格口，也可以在 Locker 维护 disabledCompartmentIds，但状态 enum 更贴合实体状态。
options_en: Delete the broken compartment directly from accessTokenMapping.
Have AccessToken also store a maintenance contact phone number.
Introduce a CompartmentStatus enum to replace the occupied boolean.
Delete the Size enum entirely.
tradeoff: 布尔值简单 vs 枚举表达三态更准确
codeSample:
enum CompartmentStatus:
    AVAILABLE
    OCCUPIED
    OUT_OF_SERVICE

isAvailable()
    return status == AVAILABLE

termDefinitions.meaning: 限定取值范围的类型，这里用来表达格口的三种互斥状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An enum is a type restricted to a fixed set of values, used here to express the compartment's three mutually exclusive states.

q: 加入维护状态后，CompartmentStatus 可能包含哪些值？（多选）
options: AVAILABLE
OCCUPIED
OUT_OF_SERVICE
TOKEN_EXPIRED
why: 维护状态描述格口本身能否分配。TOKEN_EXPIRED 是访问凭证状态，不应混进格口物理状态。
why_en: Compartment status should describe the slot's availability, not the token's lifecycle.
options_en: AVAILABLE
OCCUPIED
OUT_OF_SERVICE
TOKEN_EXPIRED

scenario: 生产系统必须保证司机确实把包裹放进格口，不能只开门后假设成功。
q: 比单阶段 deposit 更合适的流程是什么？
options: 先给用户 token，再让司机随便找一个格口
把包裹是否存在的检查留到 pickup 时才做
所有投递都改成工作人员手工登记处理
reserve 先占位开门，确认放入后 confirm 才生成 token
why: 两阶段流程先保留并开门，确认放入后才标记 occupied 并生成 token。它解决了“开门但司机离开”的空格口发码问题。
why_en: A two-phase reserve and confirm flow prevents issuing a pickup token for an empty compartment.
whenOtherWins: 在面试基础范围里，单阶段 deposit 更简单；两阶段适合需要传感器、人工确认或严格物理验证的生产系统。
options_en: Give the user a token first, then let the driver find any compartment afterward.
Defer the check for whether the package exists until pickup time.
Route every deposit through manual staff registration instead.
Reserve opens the door first; only after confirm does it issue the token.
tradeoff: 单阶段简单 vs 两阶段确认换取物理存在保证
codeSample:
reserveCompartment(size) -> reservationId   // opens door, status=RESERVED
confirmDeposit(reservationId) -> tokenCode   // status=OCCUPIED, token issued

q: 两阶段投递的正确状态变化顺序是什么？
steps: confirmDeposit 根据 reservationId 找到格口。
reserveCompartment 找可用格口并标记 RESERVED。
生成 token，标记 OCCUPIED，并删除 reservation 记录。
如果超时未确认，取消 reservation 并释放格口。
why: 核心是 token 只在确认之后产生，RESERVED 状态需要超时清理。这样避免长期占用或空格口发码。
why_en: The two-phase flow reserves first, confirms before issuing the token, and times out abandoned reservations.
diagram:
stateDiagram
  [*] --> Reserved
  Reserved --> Occupied: driver confirms
  Reserved --> Available: timeout
  Occupied --> Available: pickup

termDefinitions.meaning: 预留后若超过设定时间未确认，系统自动取消预留并释放格口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A reservation timeout automatically cancels an unconfirmed reservation and frees the compartment after a set time window.

q: invalid token 和 expired token 为什么要给不同错误？
options: invalid 一定说明包裹被盗
expired 可以继续开门
二者必须完全一样，否则无法清理
expired 说明码曾有效但窗口已过，用户应联系支持
why: 过期错误告诉用户码曾有效但窗口已过，包裹仍可能需要人工处理。随机错误或已使用码则只说明当前不可用。
why_en: An expired-token error is actionable because the package may still be in the locker awaiting staff handling.
options_en: Invalid always means the package was stolen.
An expired token can still open the door.
The two must be identical, or cleanup becomes impossible.
Expired means the code was once valid but the window passed, so the user should contact support.
tradeoff: 统一 invalid 错误换简单 vs 单独 expired 错误换可操作性

scenario: 产品经理问是否要实现失败多次后锁定取件码。
q: 根据本文基础范围应该怎么处理？
options: 先不实现，只校验错误码并返回错误
必须记录每个失败尝试和时间窗口
把失败次数写入 Compartment
失败一次就永久删除 token
why: 失败锁定会引入额外状态和时间窗口，已被澄清为 out of scope。识别但不实现它，是控制范围的表现。
why_en: Failed-attempt lockout is a scoped-out security feature that would add extra state and timing rules.
whenOtherWins: 如果安全要求明确包括防暴力破解，再为 token 或用户维护失败计数、窗口和锁定状态。
options_en: Don't implement it yet — just validate the error code and return an error.
Must log every failed attempt and its time window.
Write the failure count onto Compartment.
Permanently delete the token after a single failure.
tradeoff: 先不做换保持简单 vs 提前实现锁定换安全性

scenario: pickup(tokenCode) 是高频路径，输入 code 后要快速找到对应权限对象。
q: Locker 应该维护哪种结构？
options: List<Compartment> 并逐个比较 code
Map<Size, Package>
Map<string, AccessToken>
单个全局 currentToken
why: code 到 AccessToken 的 map 让取件查找是 O(1)。AccessToken 再持有对应 Compartment 引用，能直接开门。
why_en: A map from token code to AccessToken gives direct lookup for pickup.
whenOtherWins: 如果存储在数据库中，map 会变成 token code 上的索引，但抽象关系仍相同。
options_en: A List<Compartment> compared one by one against the code.
A Map<Size, Package>.
A Map<string, AccessToken>.
A single global currentToken.
tradeoff: 哈希表 O(1) 查找 vs 线性列表逐个比较
codeSample:
accessTokenMapping: Map<string, AccessToken>

pickup(code):
    token = accessTokenMapping.get(code)   // O(1) lookup
    if token == null: throw InvalidCode

termDefinitions.meaning: 按 key 直接定位值的数据结构，平均查找是 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map locates a value directly by key, giving average O(1) lookup.

q: 补全 Information Expert 的职责划分：
text: Locker 管理{{分配和 token 映射}}；AccessToken 管理{{过期判断}}；Compartment 管理{{物理占用状态}}。
why: 哪个对象拥有数据，哪个对象就应该最懂如何使用那份数据。这个原则让方法短小且职责稳定。
why_en: Information Expert assigns allocation to Locker, expiration to AccessToken, and physical occupancy to Compartment.

termDefinitions.meaning: GRASP 设计原则之一：谁拥有数据，谁就该实现使用这份数据的行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Information Expert is a GRASP design principle stating that the object owning the data should implement the behavior that uses it.

scenario: 开发者提议 token 一过期就从 accessTokenMapping 删除。
q: 为什么这会破坏需求？
options: 系统无法区分过期码，且工作人员仍需找到过期格口
删除 map 会让所有格口变大
token 删除后包裹会自动消失
过期码应继续允许用户取件
why: 过期后仍要返回具体过期错误，并让工作人员找到要处理的格口。提前删除会丢掉访问和清理上下文。
why_en: Deleting expired tokens immediately loses both the ability to report expiry and the mapping needed for staff handling.
whenOtherWins: 在工作人员确认移除包裹后，可以删除 expired token 并释放格口。
options_en: The system can no longer distinguish expired codes, and staff can't find the compartment to handle.
Deleting the map makes every compartment bigger.
The package disappears automatically once the token is deleted.
Expired codes should still be allowed to open the door.
tradeoff: 立即删除 token 简化 map vs 保留 token 支持过期诊断与清理

q: pickup 为什么可以返回 void，而不是返回 Package 或 Compartment？
options: 因为 pickup 不需要检查 token
因为返回 void 可以跳过清理
因为用户必须自己打开门
因为开门就是用户可见的成功反馈，不必暴露格口对象
why: locker 是与硬件联动的系统，开门就是用户可见结果。业务上不需要把格口对象暴露给调用方。
why_en: Pickup can return void because the hardware door opening is the observable success result.
options_en: Because pickup doesn't need to check the token.
Because returning void lets you skip cleanup.
Because the user has to open the door themselves.
Because the door opening is the visible success signal, so there's no need to expose the compartment object.
tradeoff: void 返回值更简洁 vs 返回对象换调用方可编程性

q: pickup 应显式处理哪些边界情况？（多选）
options: tokenCode 为空
token 不存在
token 已过期
格口尺寸比包裹大
why: pickup 路径围绕取件码有效性和期限判断。格口尺寸是投递分配时的问题，不是取件时的主要边界。
why_en: Pickup edge cases focus on token presence and expiry, while size matching belongs to deposit.
options_en: tokenCode is empty.
The token doesn't exist.
The token has expired.
The compartment is bigger than the package.

scenario: 有人想把 isExpired(token) 写成 Locker 的工具函数，而 AccessToken 只存字段。
q: 更好的职责放置是什么？
options: AccessToken.isExpired()
Locker.isExpired(token)
Compartment.isExpired()
Size.isExpired()
why: 过期时间是 AccessToken 自己的数据，过期判断也应放在它身上。Locker 只负责调用判断并编排流程。
why_en: Expiration logic belongs on AccessToken because it owns the expiration timestamp.
whenOtherWins: 如果过期策略变成可配置业务策略，也可以抽出 ExpirationPolicy，但基础题不需要。
options_en: AccessToken.isExpired()
Locker.isExpired(token)
Compartment.isExpired()
Size.isExpired()
tradeoff: 把判断放在拥有数据的 AccessToken vs 放在编排者 Locker

q: 补全与 Parking Lot 的状态归属对比：
text: Amazon Locker 把占用看作{{物理状态}}，因此放在 Compartment；Parking Lot 把占用看作{{ticket 赋值关系}}，因此可放在 orchestrator 的 Set。
why: 两题都能用多种方案，关键是说清楚领域语义。不要机械套用一个固定模式。
why_en: The article contrasts physical occupancy in lockers with assignment-style occupancy in parking lots.
scenario: 在另一道经典 LLD 题 Parking Lot 中，车位是否被占用通常由 orchestrator 维护的一个 ticket→spot 关系（比如 Set）表示，而不是车位自身的字段。

termDefinitions.meaning: Parking Lot 系统里代表一次占用关系的凭证对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In the Parking Lot system, a ticket is the object representing one occupancy assignment.

scenario: 你担心司机打开门后没放包，用户却收到了取件码。
q: 这是哪种当前设计的代价？
options: 单阶段 deposit 的假设成本
token map O(1) 查找的成本
Size enum 的成本
Compartment.getSize 的成本
why: 单阶段流程假设司机在开门后完成投递。若要消除这个假设，需要确认步骤、传感器或 reservation timeout。
why_en: The risk comes from a single-phase deposit flow that assumes the driver actually deposits the package.
whenOtherWins: 基础面试题可以接受这个假设以保持设计简洁；生产安全性更高时才引入两阶段。
options_en: The assumption cost of a single-phase deposit.
The cost of O(1) token-map lookup.
The cost of the Size enum.
The cost of Compartment.getSize.
tradeoff: 单阶段简单 vs 两阶段确认换取物理存在保证

q: 为什么线性扫描 compartments 在这种规模的 locker 里是可接受的设计？
options: locker 一定只有 1 个格口
所有语言扫描数组都是 O(1)
token 过期后就不需要扫描
几十个格口的规模下，O(n) 和 O(1) 差异可忽略
why: 格口数量级只有几十个，O(n) 扫描和 O(1) 索引的实际耗时差异小到可以忽略；这个量级判断决定了要不要为几十个元素引入按尺寸分组的队列索引。
why_en: At the scale of a few dozen compartments, the real cost difference between an O(n) scan and an O(1) indexed lookup is negligible, so it decides whether the extra size-grouped queue index is worth building.
scenario: 一个典型 Amazon Locker 站点只有 20-50 个格口；depositPackage 每次调用 getAvailableCompartment 做一次线性扫描。
options_en: A locker is assumed to always have exactly one compartment.
Array scans are O(1) in every language.
Scanning becomes unnecessary once a token expires.
At a scale of a few dozen compartments, the O(n) versus O(1) difference is negligible.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线性时间复杂度，成本随元素数量等比增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(n) is linear time complexity, where cost grows proportionally with the number of elements.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常数时间复杂度，成本几乎不随元素数量变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(1) is constant time complexity, where cost barely changes with the number of elements.

scenario: 你要实现本文选择的可用格口查找方式。
q: 这段伪代码体现了哪个设计取舍？
codeSample:
getAvailableCompartment(size)
    for c in compartments
        if c.getSize() == size && !c.isOccupied()
            return c
    return null
options: 用 Compartment 上的物理状态作为单一可用性来源
用 accessTokenMapping 推导占用
用每个 Size 的队列做 O(1) 分配
允许任何尺寸互相替代
why: 查找逻辑直接读取格口尺寸和 occupied 状态，保持简单。它故意不从 token 生命周期推导物理占用。
why_en: This scan uses the compartment's physical occupancy as the source of availability.
whenOtherWins: 极大规模或高频投递时，按尺寸维护可用队列会更快。
options_en: Use the compartment's own physical state as the single source of availability.
Derive occupancy from accessTokenMapping instead.
Maintain an O(1) queue of available compartments per size.
Allow any size to substitute for any other.
tradeoff: 单一物理状态来源简单 vs 从 token 生命周期推导更省内存但更复杂

scenario: openExpiredCompartments 扫描到多个过期 token。
q: 它应该对每个过期 token 做什么？
options: 立刻把 compartment markFree
重新生成新 token 给客户
打开对应 compartment，让工作人员物理取包
把 token 当作无效直接删除
why: 工作人员流程的第一步是打开过期包裹所在格口。释放和删除应在确认包裹被移除后发生。
why_en: openExpiredCompartments should open the compartments tied to expired tokens for staff handling, not free them prematurely.
whenOtherWins: 如果系统有 staffConfirmRemoved(tokenCode)，那个确认方法可以再清理 token 和 occupied 状态。
options_en: Immediately mark the compartment free.
Generate a brand-new token for the customer.
Open the matching compartment so staff can physically retrieve the package.
Treat the token as invalid and delete it right away.
tradeoff: 先开门给工作人员看 vs 立即清理状态

q: Senior 级回答应该主动讨论哪些 Amazon Locker 取舍？（多选）
options: Package 是否需要成为实体，或只作为 token/metadata 保留
occupied 放 Compartment 还是 orchestrator/index
过期 token 的 lazy cleanup
尺寸 fallback 和坏格口扩展
无论范围如何，都应该先实现失败次数锁定安全机制
why: 高级信号是能解释范围、状态语义和演进路径，不是不顾澄清结果强行实现被排除的功能。Package 需要追踪重量、承运商或赔付时才值得建实体；范围只围绕 token 和 compartment 时，metadata 就够。
why_en: Senior answers explain entity pruning, state ownership, lazy cleanup, and extension tradeoffs, without forcing in a feature the interviewer already scoped out, like lockout.
options_en: Whether Package needs to be a real entity, or can stay as token/metadata.
Whether occupancy lives on Compartment or in an orchestrator index.
Lazy cleanup of expired tokens.
Size fallback and handling broken compartments.
Failed-attempt lockout should always be implemented regardless of scope.

q: 按正确顺序排列 Amazon Locker 的主设计决策链：
steps: 让 Locker 作为入口，持有 compartments 和 token map。
需求只覆盖 locker 内操作，排除物流和通知。
把 AccessToken 建成带 expiration 和 compartment 引用的实体。
把 physical occupied 放在 Compartment，并在 pickup 清理。
用简单扫描查找同尺寸空格口，扩展时再考虑索引。
why: 这个链路从范围收敛开始，再落到实体、状态和性能选择。面试表达时按这个顺序更容易防止过早优化。
why_en: The design chain moves from scope to orchestrator, token entity, physical occupancy, and then allocation performance.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[scope pickup/deposit] --> B[Compartment owns physical state]
  B --> C[Token maps code to compartment]
  C --> D[pickup clears both]
  D --> E[handle expiry]

scenario: 面试最后问“这个设计的核心不变量是什么？”
q: 最重要的不变量是哪一个？
options: 一个有效 token 只对应一个被占用格口，取件成功后两者一起清理
所有包裹都必须建成独立的 Package 对象
所有格口必须按随机顺序被分配
过期 token 自动等价于格口空闲可用
why: token 映射和格口占用必须一致，且 token 生命周期不能和物理占用混淆。这个不变量支撑投递、取件和过期处理。
why_en: The central invariant is that a valid token maps to one occupied compartment and successful pickup clears both states together.
whenOtherWins: 如果采用 reservation/confirm 两阶段，还需要增加 RESERVED 不变量和 reservation timeout 清理规则。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["active token"] --> B["points to occupied compartment"]
  B --> C["contains package"]
  D["pickup or expire"] --> E["remove token"]
  E --> F["clear compartment"]
options_en: A valid token maps to exactly one occupied compartment, and a successful pickup clears both together.
Every package must have its own Package object.
Every compartment must be assigned in random order.
An expired token automatically means the compartment is free.
tradeoff: 统一清理不变量 vs 允许 token/占用状态短暂不同步
